summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.82/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.82 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 14, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 10¢ lower than a week ago, 70¢ lower than a month ago, and 94¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.59) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.03).
